bio: Vincenzo Ferlaino was baptized on 4 October 1781 at San Mango D'Aquino, Italy, the son of Bruno Ferlaino and Francesca Moraca, which makes him the younger brother of Nicola Maria Ferlaino, the grandfather of Leopoldo. On 17 March 1809 he married Maria Colosimo, daughter of Andrea Colosimo, at San Mango d'Aquino. He died there, a widower, on 10 September 1847. He is John's 5th-great-grandfather.
funFacts: Vincenzo's parents Bruno Ferlaino and Francesca Moraca are already in John's tree as Nicola Maria's parents, so they are John's ancestors twice over.
